industrial.zh: 工业革命将英国从一个农业社会转变为一个城市化的工业社会。

inferior.en: The fight response can make us belittle someone – make them feel inferior or unimportant.
inferior.zh: 战斗反应会让我们贬低某人——让他们觉得自己低人一等或微不足道。

inferior.en: To belittle someone means to make them feel inferior or unimportant.
inferior.zh: 贬低某人（to belittle someone）意为让他们觉得自己低人一等或微不足道。

inferior.en: There was nothing unusual or inferior about the British diet.
inferior.zh: 英国人的饮食并没有什么不寻常或低人一等的地方。

inferior.en: The evidence base was relatively small, so we shouldn’t overstate the conclusions of that study, but it does support the idea that learning through a screen is not inferior to learning in person.
inferior.zh: 证据基础相对较小，所以我们不应夸大该研究的结论，但它确实支持了通过屏幕学习并不逊色于线下学习的观点。

inferior.en: And one of the reasons that some Northerners feel animosity towards their Southern counterparts was because of a presumed institutional prejudice that speaking with a Northern accent and using Northern vocabulary was somehow inferior to speaking with a Southern accent.
inferior.zh: 某些北方人对南方同胞抱有敌意的原因之一，在于一种公认的体制性偏见：操北方口音、使用北方词汇在某种程度上被视为不如操南方口音高雅。

intentional.en: But it’s not just about repetition… it’s about intentional and consistent repetition with feedback.
intentional.zh: 但这不仅仅是重复……而是带着反馈的有意识且持续的重复。

intentional.en: So, to be intentional is to act with that plan or reason in mind.
intentional.zh: 因此，有意识（intentional）就是带着这种计划或理由去行动。

intentional.en: Now, let's recap the vocabulary we've learned, starting with intentional.
intentional.zh: 现在，让我们回顾一下我们学过的词汇，从“有意识的”（intentional）开始。

intentional.en: This was all intentional. The idea was to make them feel like they had lost their identity and their individuality.
intentional.zh: 这一切都是刻意为之，目的是让他们觉得自己失去了身份和个性。

intentional.en: 75% of their movements are intentional, synchronised.
intentional.zh: 他们75%的动作是有意的、同步的。

install.en: They’re often installed on entrances, on stairways, or on the outside walls facing the street.
install.zh: 它们通常安装在入口、楼梯间或面向街道的外墙上。

install.en: In recent years, many fast-food chains have installed touchscreen machines for people to order their food.
install.zh: 近年来，许多快餐连锁店都安装了触摸屏点餐机供人们点餐。

install.en: Their man, a figure named Said Mohamed Jaffar, is installed as president.
install.zh: 他们的人，一个叫 Said Mohamed Jaffar 的人物，被扶上了总统宝座。

install.en: The so-called “neutral government” that Mobutu installed quickly lost legitimacy.
install.zh: 蒙博托安插的所谓“中立政府”很快失去了合法性。

install.en: The French installed their own emperor Maximilian of Habsburg, who ruled Mexico for just a few short years.
install.zh: 法国人扶植了他们自己的皇帝哈布斯堡王朝的马克西米连，他统治墨西哥仅短短几年时间。

instance.en: For instance, you might hear someone say a party was “lit “, meaning amazing or exciting.
instance.zh: 比如，你可能会听到有人说某个派对很“lit”，意思是太棒了或令人兴奋。

instance.en: For instance, in some countries, time is treated like money.
instance.zh: 例如，在某些国家，时间被当作金钱对待。

instance.en: The adjective hard-wired describes automatically thinking or behaving in a particular way, for instance, because it's genetic.
instance.zh: 形容词“硬编码的/与生俱来的”描述的是以特定方式自动思考或行事，例如，因为它是基因决定的。

instance.en: Not all people, but I think there's definitely a large proportion of people who may feel judged in those instances and may say no.
instance.zh: 不是所有人，但我认为确实有相当一部分人在那种情况下会觉得自己被评判，然后可能会拒绝。

instance.en: For instance, by the early 1980s, the U.S. had the world’s largest fleet of reactors, which were producing just under 20% of the country’s power.
instance.zh: 例如，到20世纪80年代初，美国拥有世界上最大的反应堆集群，其发电量占该国总发电量的近20%。

incline.en: Would you like to do that? Because you've got more time and you're not being judged, you're very much more inclined to actually say yes to these things.
incline.zh: 你想这么做吗？因为你有更多时间，而且没有被评判，所以你更有可能对这些事情说“好”。

initial.en: Hannibal’s initial hope, that Rome’s allies would rise up and join him, had largely not transpired.
initial.zh: Hannibal最初的希望——即罗马的同盟会起义加入他——大部分并没有实现。

initial.en: Anyway, its initial projected cost was £18 billion, and it was expected to come online in 2025.
initial.zh: 无论如何，其最初的预计造价为180亿英镑，预计于2025年上线。

initial.en: Starmer's initial response did not include a clear no.
initial.zh: Starmer 最初的回应并没有明确说不。

initial.en: The initial settlers really struggled with disease, food shortages, and they were often in conflict with the local indigenous people.
initial.zh: 最初的定居者确实在疾病和食物短缺中挣扎，并且他们经常与当地土著居民发生冲突。

initial.en: Scipio outmanoeuvred him, used Roman discipline to resist the initial elephant charge, and then exploited gaps in the Carthaginian line.
initial.zh: 西庇阿技高一筹，利用罗马军队的纪律抵挡住了最初的战象冲锋，随后成功切入了迦太基阵型的漏洞。

instantly.en: Another example is with vocabulary. Some people seem to remember new words instantly.
instantly.zh: 另一个例子是关于词汇的。有些人似乎能瞬间记住新单词。

instantly.en: Information started to spread instantly and globally without filters or fact checking.
instantly.zh: 信息开始在没有过滤或事实核查的情况下，在全球范围内即时传播。

instantly.en: And I think it instantly represents Rio de Janeiro and Brazilian culture.
instantly.zh: 我认为它瞬间代表了里约热内卢和巴西文化。

instantly.en: The value of the British currency fell, and her government had to abandon all of those plans instantly.
instantly.zh: 英镑贬值，她的政府不得不立即废除了所有这些计划。

instantly.en: As these were commands that I had to act on instantly, it helped the language stick in my mind.
instantly.zh: 由于这些是我必须立即做出的反应的指令，这有助于这些语言在大脑中扎根。

interview.en: In these interviews, the Warmbiers stated that they believed their son had been tortured.
interview.zh: 在这些采访中，瓦姆比尔夫妇表示，他们相信儿子曾遭受过酷刑。

interview.en: The Food Chain also interviewed students at London's City of Westminster College about family dinnertimes.
interview.zh: The Food Chain 还采访了伦敦 City of Westminster College 的学生，了解他们的家庭晚餐时光。

interview.en: BBC Radio 4 programme Thinking Allowed interviewed one young man, Jason, about his debt.
interview.zh: BBC广播四台节目《Thinking Allowed》采访了一位名叫杰森的年轻男子，谈论了他的债务情况。

interview.en: Interviewing every single applicant individually would be a very inefficient way to test English ability.
interview.zh: 单独面试每一位申请人，将是测试英语能力的一种极其低效的方法。

interview.en: They often appear in sales or persuasion, media interviews, or police interrogations.
interview.zh: 它们经常出现在销售、说服、媒体采访或警方审讯中。

income.en: French traders realized they could make a really good income from the fur trade.
income.zh: 法国商人意识到，通过毛皮贸易，他们可以获得相当丰厚的收入。

income.en: Disposable income is the money you have left over after paying all your expenses.
income.zh: 可支配收入是指你支付完所有费用后剩下的钱。

income.en: Lisa started collecting toys as an adult with a job and disposable income.
income.zh: Lisa在成年后拥有了工作和可支配收入后开始收集玩具。

income.en: They want new immigrants to have higher skills, higher incomes, and stronger English language ability.
income.zh: 他们希望新移民具备更高的技能、更高的收入和更强的英语能力。

income.en: And because working-class people had limited incomes, the quality of the food was not the priority.
income.zh: 而且由于工人阶级的收入有限，食物的质量并不是首要考虑的。

inspire.en: This was inspired by an earlier Polish “Bomba” machine, but was far more advanced.
inspire.zh: 这灵感来源于早期波兰的“Bomba”机器，但要先进得多。

inspire.en: This episode was inspired by a thought I had while talking to some friends recently.
inspire.zh: 这期节目的灵感来自于我最近和一些朋友聊天时产生的一个想法。

inspire.en: It’s inspired by the idea that traditional retirement may never come.
inspire.zh: 它的灵感来自于传统的退休可能永远不会到来的想法。

inspire.en: He was inspired by the redesign of Paris in the 19th century.
inspire.zh: 他受到19世纪巴黎重新规划的启发。

inspire.en: These were subjects drawn from the classical world, inspired by the rediscovery of Greek and Roman texts.
inspire.zh: 这些学科取材于古典世界，受到对希腊和罗马文本重新发现的启发。

installation.en: By adding more relaxing sounds, Charles' art installation actually made the park feel quieter.
installation.zh: 通过添加更多放松的声音，Charles的艺术装置实际上让公园感觉更安静了。

installation.en: He created an art installation – a work of art designed to give people an interactive experience.
installation.zh: 他创作了一个艺术装置——一件旨在给人互动体验的艺术品。

inevitably.en: Inevitably means in a way that cannot be stopped or avoided.
inevitably.zh: 不可避免地意为无法阻止或避免的方式。

inevitably.en: Inevitably means in a way that cannot be stopped or avoided.
inevitably.zh: 不可避免地（Inevitably）意味着以一种无法阻止或避免的方式。

inevitably.en: This meant that when independence came, as it inevitably did in 1960, Congo was desperately unprepared to govern itself.
inevitably.zh: 这意味着，当独立时刻在1960年不可避免地到来时，刚果对自我治理毫无准备。

intricate.en: It’s constructed from white marble and decorated with intricate carvings, calligraphy, and precious stones.
intricate.zh: 它由白大理石建造，饰有复杂的雕刻、书法和宝石。

intricate.en: Maryanne describes the symbolic Chinese characters as beautifully intricate.
intricate.zh: 玛丽安娜将象征性的汉字描述为精美复杂。

intricate.en: And intricate describes something which has lots of detail.
intricate.zh: 而“复杂的”（intricate）描述了有很多细节的东西。

ingredient.en: David tasted perpetual stew, a pot into which ingredients are placed and cooked continuously.
ingredient.zh: 大卫品尝了永生炖菜，这是一个不断放入食材并持续烹饪的锅。

ingredient.en: Annabel describes ultra-processed foods as things containing ingredients you wouldn't find in your kitchen.
ingredient.zh: Annabel将超加工食品描述为包含你在厨房里找不到的成分的东西。

ingredient.en: Some of the staple ingredients Natalia used in Ukraine weren't available in the Netherlands.
ingredient.zh: Natalia在乌克兰使用的一些主食配料在荷兰买不到。

ingredient.en: And if you are heavy-handed with an ingredient, you use too much of it.
ingredient.zh: 如果你对某种食材“heavy-handed”，意思就是你用得太多了。

ingredient.en: Not quite. There’s one more ingredient that separates average learners from expert learners.
ingredient.zh: 还不够。还有一个因素将普通学习者与专家学习者区分开来。

invent.en: To explore this, he invented an imaginary device, we now call the Turing Machine.
invent.zh: 为了探讨这一点，他发明了一种假想的装置，我们现在称之为 Turing Machine。

invent.en: But humans used many different formats for storing written information before books were invented.
invent.zh: 但在书籍发明之前，人类使用许多不同的格式来存储书面信息。

invent.en: What people were paying attention to. What people were concerned about, confused by, or inventing.
invent.zh: 人们当时在关注什么，在担忧什么，对什么感到困惑，又在创造着什么。

invent.en: History is not a competition. These ancient societies didn’t race to build pyramids or invent writing.
invent.zh: 历史不是一场比赛。这些古代社会并没有竞相建造金字塔或发明文字。

invent.en: Before humans invented writing, our knowledge had to be passed down orally.
invent.zh: 在人类发明文字之前，我们的知识必须通过口头传递。

insect.en: Yes, that's right. In some parts of the world, edible insects are crunched too.
insect.zh: 是的，没错。在世界某些地方，可食用的昆虫也是嘎吱嘎吱吃的。

insect.en: Darwin loved collecting insects, examining rocks, and learning about the natural world.
insect.zh: Darwin热爱收集昆虫、检查岩石以及了解自然界。

insect.en: So, are animals black and white to repel insects, like zebras, or for camouflage, like pandas?
insect.zh: 那么，动物呈现黑白两色是为了像斑马那样驱赶昆虫，还是像熊猫那样为了伪装呢？

insect.en: So, zebras' stripes confuse insects, telling them to look elsewhere for food.
insect.zh: 所以，斑马的条纹迷惑了昆虫，告诉它们去别处寻找食物。

insect.en: But now, thanks to modern farming methods, populations of many insects, including bees, are in decline.
insect.zh: 但现在，由于现代农业方法的发展，包括蜜蜂在内的许多昆虫种群数量正在下降。

increasingly.en: Mobutu, who was now ageing and increasingly unwell, was forced to start promising reforms.
increasingly.zh: 年事已高且健康状况每况愈下的蒙博托被迫开始承诺改革。

increasingly.en: To a lot of people, that was increasingly not funny, not something they wanted to watch.
increasingly.zh: 对许多人来说，这越来越不好笑了，这不是他们想看的东西。

increasingly.en: And banks became increasingly willing to lend larger multiples of people’s incomes.
increasingly.zh: 银行也越来越愿意提供相当于人们收入更高倍数的贷款。

increasingly.en: Others had been diplomatically absorbed, sucked up by this increasingly dominant power.
increasingly.zh: 另一些则是通过外交手段被吞并，被这个日益主导的强权所蚕食。

increasingly.en: But increasingly, this work is now done using artificial intelligence, or AI.
increasingly.zh: 但现在，这项工作越来越多地开始使用人工智能，也就是AI来完成。

indoors.en: They were given names. They slept indoors.
indoors.zh: 它们被起了名字。它们睡在室内。

indoors.en: I'm Neil. And I'm Georgie. In winter, people find different ways of keeping warm, like wearing extra clothes or staying indoors, but in some countries there's another way of keeping the cold out – going for a sauna.
indoors.zh: 我是 Neil。我是 Georgie。在冬天，人们会用不同的方式来保暖，比如多穿衣服或待在室内，但在一些国家，还有另一种御寒的方法——蒸桑拿。

interfere.en: Observational data is information collected from watching people's natural behaviour without interfering in it.
interfere.zh: “Observational data”（观察性数据）是指在不进行干预的情况下，通过观察人们的自然行为收集的信息。

interfere.en: Some people feel that the EU interferes too much in national politics.
interfere.zh: 有些人觉得欧盟对国家政治干预过多。

interfere.en: A conflict of interest happens when someone’s personal interests interfere with their professional job, their professional responsibilities.
interfere.zh: 利益冲突发生在某人的个人利益与其职业工作、职业责任产生冲突的时候。

interfere.en: Ole’s claims sound too good to be true. But are there downsides to interfering with nature in this way?
interfere.zh: 奥莱的说法听起来好得令人难以置信。但以这种方式干涉大自然有什么负面影响吗？

interfere.en: They have to avoid strong smells, precisely so that there is nothing interfering with their ability to detect the subtle nuances of different smells.
interfere.zh: 他们必须避开强烈的气味，恰恰是为了不让任何东西干扰他们辨别不同气味细微差别的能力。

invention.en: These were early models or concepts of inventions that had never been built before.
invention.zh: 这些是从未被建造过的新发明的早期模型或概念。

invention.en: And with the invention of the torpedo, the submarine became a viable and deadly military asset.
invention.zh: 随着鱼雷的发明，潜艇成为了一种可行且致命的军事资产。

invention.en: He was a Neapolitan invention, and he had a hooked nose and a hump on his back.
invention.zh: 他是那不勒斯人的创造，有着鹰钩鼻和驼背。

invention.en: But this has changed with the recent invention of weight loss drugs.
invention.zh: 但随着最近减肥药的发明，这种情况已经发生了改变。

invention.en: The invention of the printing press made it so much easier to produce exam papers and textbooks.
invention.zh: 印刷术的发明使得印刷试卷和教科书变得容易得多。

inject.en: Weight loss drugs are injected into the tummy and replicate this effect, but last much longer.
inject.zh: 减肥药被注射到腹部，并复制这种效果，但持续时间要长得多。

index.en: The NASDAQ Stock Index, which included many tech companies, lost nearly 80% of its value.
index.zh: 纳斯达克股票指数包含了许多科技公司，其价值损失了近80%。

index.en: Yes, that's because I was sure the answer is b) body mass index.
index.zh: 是的，那是因为我确信答案是 b) 身体质量指数。

index.en: But what does BMI stand for? Is it: a) British medical index? b) Body mass index? or, c) Body muscle index?
index.zh: 但 BMI 代表什么？是：a) 英国医学指数？b) 身体质量指数？还是 c) 身体肌肉指数？

index.en: Rankings such as the EF English Proficiency Index measure how well people speak English in different countries, but they do not measure the quality of English language schools or tell us where a foreign learner will improve the most.
index.zh: 像EF英语熟练度指数这样的排名衡量的是不同国家的人英语说得怎么样，但它们并没有衡量英语语言学校的质量，也没有告诉我们外国学习者在哪里能取得最大的进步。

inner.en: It allows them to raise their inner eyebrows to create what we call " puppy dog eyes."
inner.zh: 这块肌肉能让它们的内眉上扬，做出我们所说的“小狗般委屈的眼神”。

inner.en: Over many years, this inner conflict damaged Lynn's self-esteem, her belief and confidence in her own abilities.
inner.zh: 多年来，这种内心冲突伤害了 Lynn 的自尊心，即她对自身能力的信念和信心。

inner.en: Here, for example, the brain works harder to compensate for a weaker sound signal reaching the inner ear.
inner.zh: 例如，在这里，大脑会更加努力地工作，以弥补到达内耳的较弱声音信号。

inner.en: They don't feel so cold. Subjectively means based on your personal inner experience rather than objective facts.
inner.zh: 他们不觉得那么冷。Subjectively（主观地）意味着基于你个人的内心体验，而不是客观事实。

inner.en: The ear is made up of outer, middle and inner parts.
inner.zh: 耳朵由外耳、中耳和内耳三部分组成。

intense.en: It was the year of Brexit, the US presidential election, and intense political polarisation.
intense.zh: 那一年发生了英国脱欧公投、美国总统大选，政治两极分化也异常激烈。

intense.en: Food culture there relies on using lots of intense flavors and spices.
intense.zh: 那里的饮食文化依赖于使用大量浓烈的风味和香料。

intense.en: Unification also brought intense national pride and a strong sense of militarism.
intense.zh: 统一也带来了强烈的民族自豪感和强烈的军国主义意识。

intense.en: But it also sparked intense controversy, especially among religious communities.
intense.zh: 但它也引发了激烈的争议，尤其是在宗教界。

intense.en: The process was intense. I decided to take all of the classes required in just four weeks.
intense.zh: 这个过程非常紧张。我决定在短短四周内完成所有要求的课程。

incorrect.en: ...but unfortunately, it was incorrect. Oh no!
Because if you’re not asking good questions, the information that you get from Google or from Gemini may be incorrect or not exactly what you are hoping for.
