incorrect.en: For example, a powerful emotional story can outweigh scientific data and people prioritize information that supports their existing worldview, even if that information is incorrect.
incorrect.zh: 例如，一个强烈的感人故事可以盖过科学数据，人们会优先选择支持其现有世界观的信息，即使这些信息并不正确。

industry.en: A country that depends on just one industry or one resource has very few alternatives.
industry.zh: 一个依赖单一产业或单一资源的国家几乎没有其他选择。

industry.en: And it was during this time that the modern perfume industry began to take shape.
industry.zh: 正是在这段时间里，现代香水产业开始成形。

industry.en: Or maybe look for idioms or jargon terms that are often used in your industry.
industry.zh: 或者寻找在你所在的行业中经常使用的习语或行话。

industry.en: Because oil has been so profitable, other industries, especially manufacturing, have received less investment.
industry.zh: 因为石油利润丰厚，其他行业（尤其是制造业）获得的投资较少。

industry.en: Montreal has become a place recognized for its aerospace and artificial intelligence industries.
industry.zh: 蒙特利尔已成为一个以航空航天和人工智能产业闻名的城市。

introduction.en: Understandably, the introduction of the minimum wage proved popular with workers, and the idea quickly spread.
introduction.zh: 可以理解的是，最低工资的引入受到了工人们的欢迎，这一理念迅速传播开来。

introduction.en: The introduction of AI has turned some users away from social media.
introduction.zh: AI 的引入让一些用户远离了社交媒体。

introduction.en: It's pretty much the same thing. Now, even after the introduction of pensions and of national insurance, the workhouse remained.
introduction.zh: 这基本上是一回事。然而，即使在养老金和国民保险引入之后，济贫院依然存在。

introduction.en: As I mentioned in the introduction, Leonardo da Vinci has been described as the perfect example of a Renaissance man, so we should probably talk about the Renaissance.
introduction.zh: 正如我在引言中提到的，列奥纳多·达·芬奇一直被描述为文艺复兴人的完美典范，所以我们可能应该谈谈文艺复兴。

integral.en: To be part and parcel of something means to be an essential or integral feature of it.
integral.zh: 成为某事的 part and parcel 意味着它是该事物必不可少的或不可分割的特征。

integral.en: Here, Rachel explains some of the food challenges she faced to BBC World Service programme, 'The Food Chain': When I came out to the Caribbean, I was really in for a shock when it came to flavouring and seasoning food, and seasoning is really, really an integral part of food preparation here.
integral.zh: 在这里，Rachel向BBC世界频道节目《The Food Chain》解释了她所面临的一些食物挑战：当我来到加勒比海时，在食物调味和加香料方面，我真的受到了很大的冲击，而加香料真的是这里食物准备中不可或缺的一部分。

intake.en: Dr Karan also gives some hacks – good solutions or pieces of advice – to help boost your fibre intake.
intake.zh: Karan博士还给出了一些“hacks”——好的解决方法或建议——来帮助提高你的纤维摄入量。

intake.en: Historically, probably not. I think the tide is turning, and there's more people interested in fibre and optimising their fibre intake and fibermaxxing even – it's a trend on TikTok.
intake.zh: 从历史来看，可能没有。我认为风向正在转变，越来越多的人对纤维感兴趣，优化他们的纤维摄入量，甚至进行“fibermaxxing”——这是TikTok上的一个潮流。

intake.en: And my own work would tend to suggest that having your largest meal of the day in the morning period gives you a much better appetite control, which then means it's much easier to control food intake later in the day.
intake.zh: 我自己的研究倾向于表明，在早晨吃一天中最大的一餐能给你提供好得多的食欲控制，这反过来意味着更容易控制晚些时候的食物摄入量。

intrigue.en: But I'm still intrigued by your question, Neil.
intrigue.zh: 但我仍然对你的问题很感兴趣，Neil。

intrigue.en: And this intrigue over whether it still exists has led to some pretty awful crimes being committed in the name of the Knights Templar.
intrigue.zh: 这种对它是否依然存在的猜测，导致了一些以圣殿骑士团之名犯下的恶劣罪行。

intrigue.en: And right from the very early days, it was the subject of intrigue and mystery for students at the university, students who were not members, of course.
intrigue.zh: 而且从很早的时候起，它就是大学里学生们津津乐道和充满神秘感的话题，当然，这些学生都不是会员。

intrigue.en: The seas and oceans have always been a subject of intrigue and mystery, with their storms, high waves, and strange creatures that lurk beneath the surface.
intrigue.zh: 由于狂风暴雨、滔天巨浪和潜伏在水面之下的奇异生物，海洋和大海一直是阴谋和神秘的主题。

institution.en: This was Yale University, one of the most prestigious institutions in the United States.
institution.zh: 这里是耶鲁大学，美国最负盛名的高等学府之一。

institution.en: If a country already has strong institutions, resources might strengthen its economy, like Norway.
institution.zh: 如果一个国家已经拥有强大的机构，资源可能会增强其经济，就像挪威一样。

institution.en: If we know all that, then we can begin to build institutions that counteract them.
institution.zh: 如果我们了解这一切，就可以着手建立能够抵消这些因素的制度。

institution.en: For example, they limited the use of Polish language in schools and some government institutions.
institution.zh: 例如，他们限制了波兰语在学校和一些政府机构中的使用。

institution.en: An erosion of trust happens when people gradually lose confidence in political and economic institutions.
institution.zh: 当人们对政治和经济机构的信心逐渐丧失时，就会发生信任流失（erosion of trust）。

international.en: But it rebuilt itself, and now the city is modern, international, and in Poland.
international.zh: 但它完成了自我重建，如今这座城市既现代、国际化，又深植于波兰。

international.en: And when international tourists dream of visiting Brazil, Rio is usually their first destination.
international.zh: 当国际游客梦想游览巴西时，里约通常是他们的第一目的地。

international.en: Vancouver is a place of technology and film production and international trade with Asia.
international.zh: 温哥华则是科技、影视制作以及与亚洲开展国际贸易的重镇。

international.en: What they ended up developing was an early form of banking and international money transfer.
international.zh: 他们最终发展出的是早期的银行业和国际汇款业务。

international.en: He gives speeches, receives foreign dignitaries, travels abroad to represent the Comoros at international meetings.
international.zh: 他发表演讲、接见外国贵宾、出国代表科摩罗参加国际会议。

invite.en: “Yes, I finished a report.” Open questions, on the other hand, invite explanation.
invite.zh: “是的，我写完报告了。”另一方面，开放式问题则能引发进一步的解释。

invite.en: You are invited to a party. The invitation says the party starts at 8:00 PM.
invite.zh: 你受邀去参加一个派对。邀请函上写着派对在晚上8:00开始。

invite.en: Almost five centuries earlier, the exiled King Diarmait had invited the English over to Ireland.
invite.zh: 大约五个世纪前，流亡国王 Diarmait 邀请英国人来到爱尔兰。

invite.en: But not everyone feels comfortable with the idea of inviting a human-like robot into their home.
invite.zh: 但并不是每个人都能欣然接受把一个像人类一样的机器人请进自己家里的想法。

invite.en: Third, a good question invites a useful or interesting answer.
invite.zh: 第三，一个好问题能引出有用或有趣的答案。

incredible.en: Using these he found new ways to calculate the number PI with incredible accuracy.
incredible.zh: 利用这些，他找到了以惊人精度计算圆周率PI的新方法。

incredible.en: But when you stop to consider them, they’re an incredible testament to human ingenuity.
incredible.zh: 但当你停下来思考它们时，它们是人类创造力的不可思议的证明。

incredible.en: It's an incredible system, but unfortunately one that can go wrong at any stage.
incredible.zh: 这是一个不可思议的系统，但不幸的是，它在任何阶段都可能出问题。

incredible.en: The Incas didn’t have iron tools or wheeled transport, but they still created these incredible cities.
incredible.zh: 印加人没有铁器工具或轮式运输工具，但他们仍然创造了这些不可思议的城市。

incredible.en: In my case, my first two years of studying Japanese were incredible.
incredible.zh: 就我而言，我学习日语的前两年简直不可思议。

instruct.en: A meeting had been called, and senior Nazi leaders had been instructed to fly in for it.
instruct.zh: 当时召集了一场会议，并已指示纳粹高层官员乘机前来参加。

instruct.en: There was a way, they had been told. Ask him to pull down his trousers, the British police instructed them.
instruct.zh: 英国警方指示说，有一个办法：让他脱下裤子。

instruct.en: Milgram had instructed them to give specific responses.
instruct.zh: 米尔格拉姆事先指示他们要给出特定的回应。

instruct.en: When he got one wrong, and he was scripted to get many wrong, the teacher was instructed to administer a shock, increasing the voltage with each error.
instruct.zh: 每当他答错——而按照剧本，他会故意答错很多题——“教师”就被要求施以电击，并且每错一次就提高一次电压。

instruct.en: Some heads of federal agencies instructed their employees not to respond, others instructed them to respond, others to respond, but to their direct manager, not to the original email.
instruct.zh: 一些联邦机构的负责人指示他们的员工不要回复，另一些人则指示他们回复，还有人指示他们回复，但要发给他们的直接经理，而不是发给原始邮件。

indulge.en: Crisps, confectionery and chocolate, or savoury snacks and biscuits." And the answer was… b) confectionery and chocolate, which 45% of Britons indulge in weekly, according to that survey.
indulge.zh: 薯片、糖果和巧克力，还是咸味小吃和饼干。”答案是……b) 糖果和巧克力，根据该调查，45% 的英国人每周都会纵情享用它们。

indulge.en: And it is a well-deserved reputation. Because while the Romans indulged in excess, and the Middle East perfected the science, it was in France that perfume became an art form.
indulge.zh: 而且这个声誉实至名归。因为虽然罗马人沉溺于穷奢极欲，中东人完善了科学，但正是在法国，香水变成了一门艺术。

intend.en: Since the role went to the runner-up, it wasn’t intended to hold much influence.
intend.zh: 既然这个职位落到了第二名头上，它本来就没打算拥有多大影响力。

intend.en: Guns with scratched-off serial numbers, for example, weapons that were clearly intended to be used for murder.
intend.zh: 例如，被磨掉序列号的枪支，这些武器显然是打算用来谋杀的。

intend.en: Some of these were intended to be portable for military use.
intend.zh: 其中一些旨在方便军事使用而设计成便携式的。

intend.en: The Portuguese royal family had intended their stay to be temporary.
intend.zh: 葡萄牙王室本来打算只是暂住。

intend.en: Money intended for public services can disappear in corrupt countries.
intend.zh: 本应用於公共服务的资金可能会在腐败的国家里不翼而飞。

innovation.en: The Union could push for digital innovation and the regulation of big tech.
innovation.zh: 欧盟可以推动数字创新以及对大型科技公司的监管。

innovation.en: Even if a bubble bursts, it can leave behind useful innovation, useful technology.
innovation.zh: 即使泡沫破裂，它也能留下有用的创新和有用的技术。

innovation.en: So, Professor Fankhauser thinks that degrowth underestimates many things, such as innovation.
innovation.zh: 所以，Fankhauser 教授认为“减增长”低估了许多事情，比如创新。

innovation.en: History shows us that bubbles can be risky, but they often leave behind innovation and new technology.
innovation.zh: 历史告诉我们，泡沫可能具有风险，但它们往往会留下创新和新技术。

innovation.en: Cities like Florence became places for creativity and innovation.
innovation.zh: 像佛罗伦萨这样的城市成为了充满创造力和创新精神的地方。

investment.en: So all of this growth and excitement creates a lot of attention and investment.
investment.zh: 因此，所有这些增长和狂热吸引了大量的关注和投资。

investment.en: Norway created a sovereign wealth fund. A sovereign wealth fund is a government-owned investment fund.
investment.zh: 挪威创建了一个主权财富基金。主权财富基金是政府拥有的投资基金。

investment.en: Joining the EU has often meant access to new markets and investment and financial support.
investment.zh: 加入欧盟通常意味着能够进入新的市场、获得投资和财政支持。

investment.en: Interests can mean things like investments business ownings or things that they are connected to.
investment.zh: 利益可以指投资、企业所有权或他们与之相关联的事物等。

investment.en: Because oil has been so profitable, other industries, especially manufacturing, have received less investment.
investment.zh: 因为石油利润丰厚，其他行业（尤其是制造业）获得的投资较少。

interior.en: As well as social media, decluttering has become popular with television shows, including the BBC's Interior Design Masters.
interior.zh: 除了社交媒体，断舍离在电视节目中也变得很受欢迎，包括BBC的《室内设计大师》。

interior.en: Thousands of gold prospectors rushed into the interior of Brazil.
interior.zh: 成千上万的黄金勘探者涌入巴西内陆。

interior.en: Now, MBN was a serious figure. He was the Interior Minister, a known counter-terrorism expert, and a favoured long-time partner of Western intelligence agencies, including the CIA.
interior.zh: MBN可不是个简单人物。他是内政大臣，著名的反恐专家，也是包括中情局在内的西方情报机构青睐的长期合作伙伴。

indicate.en: They continued for 8,184 metres before the rope went slack, indicating that the bottom had been hit.
indicate.zh: 他们一直下放了8,184米，直到绳子变松，表明已经触底。

indicate.en: He uses the phrase, as far as I am concerned, to indicate that he is giving his own opinion on the subject.
indicate.zh: 他用“就我而言”这个短语来表明他对这个主题表达自己的看法。

instrument.en: She developed highly precise instruments to detect and measure radiation levels.
instrument.zh: 她开发了高度精确的仪器来检测和测量辐射水平。

instrument.en: And Bob Denard was one of Foccart's most reliable instruments.
instrument.zh: 而 Bob Denard 正是 Jacques Foccart 最可靠的工具之一。

instrument.en: It was a grim lesson in how “civilised” nations could turn technology and organisation into instruments of mass destruction.
instrument.zh: 这是一次残酷的教训，让他们看清了“文明”国家如何将技术和组织变成大规模毁灭的工具。

instrument.en: They crossed thousands of kilometers of open ocean in a large double-hulled canoes without compasses, maps, or modern instruments.
instrument.zh: 他们驾驶着大型双体独木舟，在没有指南针、地图或现代仪器的帮助下，横渡了数千公里的开阔海洋。

instrument.en: This dual role—as both a profit-driven organisation and a geopolitical instrument—sets Wagner apart from other PMCs like Blackwater.
instrument.zh: 这种双重角色——既是营利性组织又是地缘政治工具——使瓦格纳区别于黑水公司等其他 PMC。

interpret.en: And the court would interpret the laws. Each branch of government could limit each other.
interpret.zh: 法院解释法律。政府的每个分支都可以互相制衡。

interpret.en: Teachers are pretty good at comprehending a variety of different accents and also interpreting your mistakes.
interpret.zh: 老师非常擅长理解各种不同的口音，也能解读你的错误。

interpret.en: Then there’s the European Court of Justice, which ensures that EU law is interpreted and applied consistently.
interpret.zh: 然后是欧洲法院，它确保欧盟法律得到一致的解释和应用。

interpret.en: The main difference between growth and fixed mindsets is how you interpret, how you understand, your ability.
interpret.zh: 成长型思维和固定型思维的主要区别在于你如何诠释、如何理解自己的能力。

interpret.en: Now, that has been interpreted by you as non-threatening to you.
interpret.zh: 现在，这被你解读为对你没有威胁性。

insult.en: For the English Crown, this wasn't just a religious insult; it was a massive security risk.
insult.zh: 对英国王室来说，这不仅是宗教上的侮辱，更是巨大的安全风险。

insult.en: You don't see him as insulting you, and you're actually quite kindly disposed to that person.
insult.zh: 你并不认为他在侮辱你，实际上你对这个人抱有好感。

insult.en: To insult someone means to be rude or offensive to them.
insult.zh: 侮辱某人意味着对他们粗鲁或无礼。

insult.en: He hit people. He insulted figures of authority.
insult.zh: 他打人。他侮辱权威人士。

insult.en: Ali was speaking during Islamophobia Awareness Month, and his target was clear — protection for Islam, in particular, from public mockery and insult.
insult.zh: Ali 发言时正值伊斯兰恐惧症宣传月，他的目标很明确——特别是要求保护伊斯兰教免受公众嘲笑和侮辱。

invest.en: He moved to California and started working in venture capital, investing in technology startups.
invest.zh: 他搬到加利福尼亚，开始从事风险投资，投资科技初创公司。

invest.en: Instead of spending all of their money earned from oil immediately, Norway invests it.
invest.zh: 挪威没有立即花掉从石油中赚取的所有钱，而是将其投资出去。

invest.en: Different governments have invested their diamond revenues into infrastructure and healthcare and education.
invest.zh: 不同的政府将钻石收入投资于基础设施、医疗保健和教育。

invest.en: A second point is that zoos often invest in research programmes that help endangered animals.
invest.zh: 第二点是，动物园经常投资于帮助濒危动物的研究项目。

invest.en: People who invested in overvalued AI companies could see their investments drop sharply in value.
invest.zh: 投资于被高估的AI公司的投资者会看到他们的投资价值急剧下降。

infect.en: OK, let's see what I can infect you with by the end of the show.
infect.zh: 好的，让我们看看节目结束前我能把什么传染给你。

infect.en: As a result, millions of people became infected before the seriousness of the situation was fully understood.
infect.zh: 结果，在人们充分认识到局势的严重性之前，数百万人已被感染。

infect.en: Take, for example, oud, which is a resin produced by a particular type of tree when it becomes infected with mould.
infect.zh: 以沉香（oud）为例，它是一种特定类型的树木在被霉菌感染时产生的树脂。

infect.en: If someone eats bread made with infected rye, they might become very sick, have convulsions, feel like they’re being pinched or burned, or even see things that aren’t really there.
infect.zh: 如果有人吃了用受感染黑麦做成的面包，他们可能会病得不轻、浑身抽搐、感觉自己被掐或被灼烧，甚至看到根本不存在的东西。

intimidate.en: To be intimidated means to feel frightened or nervous because you lack confidence in a situation.
intimidate.zh: “感到害怕”（Intimidated）意味着在某种情况下因为缺乏自信而感到害怕或紧张。

intimidate.en: Maanvi thinks some men are intimidated by her popularity on Instagram.
intimidate.zh: Maanvi认为有些男人对她在 Instagram 上的受欢迎程度感到害怕。

intimidate.en: They robbed stagecoaches. They intimidated people.
intimidate.zh: 他们打劫驿马车，恐吓当地居民。

intimidate.en: Dogs were used in warfare. The Assyrians, the Romans, and later medieval armies all used large dogs to intimidate enemies, guard camps, and even fight.
intimidate.zh: 狗曾被用于战争。亚述人、罗马人以及后来的中世纪军队都曾使用大型犬来威吓敌人、看守营地甚至参战。

intimidate.en: That randomness is the point. You cannot bribe, pressurise or intimidate twelve strangers before they walk into the room, because you do not know who they are.
intimidate.zh: 这种随机性正是关键所在。你无法在十二个陌生人走进法庭之前贿赂、施压或恐吓他们，因为你根本不知道他们是谁。

intervention.en: The DRC has experienced dictatorships, corruption, foreign intervention, and wars.
intervention.zh: 刚果（金）经历了独裁统治、腐败、外国干涉和战争。

intervention.en: What doctors had instead was a set of interventions built on theories about the body that were already centuries out of date.
intervention.zh: 相反，医生们使用的一套干预措施，是建立在那些已经落后了几个世纪的身体理论之上的。

intervention.en: In other words, the lowest salaries in society are higher than ever before, thanks to government intervention, laws protecting workers from low pay.
intervention.zh: 换句话说，由于政府的干预和保护工人免受低薪待遇的法律，社会最低工资比以往任何时候都要高。

intervention.en: With the backing of Belgian and, most likely, also U.S. intelligence, Mobutu orchestrated a coup -like intervention that removed Lumumba from power.
intervention.zh: 在比利时情报机构、且极有可能是美国情报机构的支持下，蒙博托策划了一场类似政变的干预，将卢蒙巴赶下台。

intervention.en: It holds that individuals act rationally to pursue their goals, and that central planning or state intervention distorts prices and leads to inefficiency.
intervention.zh: 该学派认为，个人会理性地采取行动以追求自己的目标，而中央计划或国家干预会扭曲价格并导致效率低下。

intimate.en: I bring transparency to the conversation, and own it, and say that I'm going to be asking you some quite personal questions, and there may be also intimate examination… I want to assure you that this is confidential, that this is a safe, non-judgmental space…
intimate.zh: 我在谈话中会保持透明，主动承担，并告诉对方我接下来要问一些相当私人的问题，可能还会有一些比较私密的检查……我想向你保证这是保密的，这是一个安全、不带评判的空间……

intimate.en: He is said to have prostituted the wives of noblemen, inviting senators and their wives to banquets, then forcing the wives, one by one, into side rooms, forcing them to have sex with him and then describing their performance in intimate detail, publicly, in front of their husbands.
intimate.zh: 据说他出卖贵族们的妻子，邀请元老院议员和他们的妻子参加宴会，然后强迫这些妻子一个接一个地进入侧室，强迫她们与他发生性关系，接着在她们的丈夫面前公开、极其细致地描述她们的表现。

intelligence.en: Another issue is questions designed to show intelligence rather than get an answer.
intelligence.zh: 另一个问题是，有些提问的目的不是为了得到答案，而是为了炫耀智商。

intelligence.en: Montreal has become a place recognized for its aerospace and artificial intelligence industries.
intelligence.zh: 蒙特利尔已成为一个以航空航天和人工智能产业闻名的城市。

intelligence.en: His long-term impact can be seen across computer science, artificial intelligence, and cryptography.
intelligence.zh: 他长期的深远影响遍及计算机科学、人工智能和密码学。

intelligence.en: But increasingly, this work is now done using artificial intelligence, or AI.
intelligence.zh: 但现在，这项工作越来越多地开始使用人工智能，也就是AI来完成。

intelligence.en: And he asked questions about machines that still shape how we think about artificial intelligence today.
intelligence.zh: 并且，他关于机器的种种思考，至今仍在塑造着我们对人工智能的理解。

infant.en: One error, or mistake, infants make is calling a giraffe a ‘raffe’ because they cut off the first syllable 'gi' because it's not stressed.
infant.zh: 婴儿犯的一个错误或失误是把长颈鹿叫作‘raffe’，因为他们切掉了第一个音节 ‘gi’，因为它没有被重读。

infant.en: This expression mimics the look of a human infant, a baby, which triggers a nurturing response in our brains and makes us want to protect them.
infant.zh: 这种表情模仿了人类婴儿的面容，会在我们的大脑中触发一种培育照顾的本能，让我们想要保护它们。

infant.en: It was somewhat unexpected. Maria was 41, as was Vladimir, and they had already had two sons, both of whom had died: the first as an infant and the second in the siege of Leningrad.
infant.zh: 这多少有些出人意料。当时玛丽亚和弗拉基米尔都41岁了，他们之前已经有过两个儿子，但不幸都夭折了：大儿子在婴儿时期夭折，二儿子则死于列宁格勒围城战。

independent.en: Lee Kuan Yew believed that Singapore might struggle to survive as an independent country.
independent.zh: 李光耀认为，作为一个独立的国家，新加坡可能难以生存。

independent.en: And remember Mayotte. When the Comoros Islands became independent, Mayotte chose to remain French.
independent.zh: 还记得马约特吗。当科摩罗群岛独立时，马约特选择保持法国属性。

independent.en: This was a big step towards independence, but Singapore was not an independent country yet.
independent.zh: 这是迈向独立的重要一步，但新加坡还不是一个独立的国家。

independent.en: You can be an independent candidate, but most candidates are aligned to a political party.
independent.zh: 你可以作为独立候选人，但大多数候选人都隶属于某个政党。

independent.en: When the Comoros Islands became independent from France in 1975, Mayotte chose to remain French.
independent.zh: 当科摩罗群岛于1975年脱离法国独立时，马约特选择继续留在法国。

intervene.en: The Ottoman government and the Ottoman ruler, the Sultan, were doing little to intervene.
intervene.zh: 奥斯曼政府和奥斯曼统治者苏丹几乎没有采取任何干预措施。

intervene.en: Housing bubbles burst, major financial institutions collapsed, and governments were forced to intervene.
intervene.zh: 房地产泡沫破裂，主要金融机构倒闭，各国政府被迫干预。

intervene.en: To intervene means to become involved in a difficult situation in order to improve it.
intervene.zh: 干预（intervene）意味着卷入一个困难的局面以便改善它。

intervene.en: However, it’s unusual for governments to intervene - to become involved - in people’s private lives this way.
intervene.zh: 然而，政府以这种方式干预——介入——人们的私生活是不寻常的。

intervene.en: They remained across the river and did not intervene in time.
intervene.zh: 他们驻扎在河对岸，并未及时施以援手。

invariably.en: She says a lack of communication is invariably - or always - the reason for divorce.
invariably.zh: 她说，缺乏沟通总是——或者一直是——离婚的原因。

invariably.en: And finally, the adverb invariably means always.
invariably.zh: 最后，副词“总是”（invariably）的意思是始终。

inch.en: So, you might be surprised to hear that until recently the government of Japan still used three and-a-half inch floppy disks to store official documents; that around the world, music cassettes and Walkmans are making a comeback; and that even the world-famous Swiss CERN physics laboratory uses old-fashioned magnetic tape reels to record its data.
inch.zh: 所以，听到以下这些消息你可能会感到惊讶：直到最近，日本政府仍在使用3.5英寸软盘来存储官方文件；在世界各地，音乐磁带和Walkman正在卷土重来；甚至世界著名的瑞士CERN物理实验室也在使用老式的磁带盘来记录数据。

invasion.en: As you may know, that didn’t last particularly long, just 7 months after the invasion.
invasion.zh: 你可能也知道，那并没有持续太久，就在入侵后仅仅7个月。

invasion.en: But perhaps the most chilling example of Putin’s ruthlessness has been his invasion of Ukraine.
invasion.zh: 但普京冷酷无情最令人毛骨悚然的例子，或许莫过于他对乌克兰的入侵。

invasion.en: Natalia Tkachenko arrived in the Netherlands after leaving her home in Ukraine, following the Russian invasion.
invasion.zh: Natalia Tkachenko在俄罗斯入侵乌克兰后，离开了自己的家乡来到荷兰。

invasion.en: But they were wrong. British soldiers and the Canadian militia resisted invasion.
invasion.zh: 但他们错了。英国士兵和加拿大地方民兵进行了顽强的抵抗。

invasion.en: The young country faced economic problems, political chaos, and foreign invasions.
invasion.zh: 这个年轻的国家面临着经济问题、政治混乱和外国入侵。

intensive.en: Then came generative AI which, as I'm sure you know, or might remember from episode 585, has much more intensive energy requirements.
intensive.zh: 随后出现了生成式人工智能，正如你肯定知道的，或者可能还记得第585期节目中所说的，它对能源的需求要密集得多。

intensive.en: I realized that with the right conditions, like intensive study, immediate application and immersion, it’s possible to learn hundreds of new words and grammar patterns in just a few weeks.
intensive.zh: 我意识到，在正确的条件下，比如强化学习、立即应用和沉浸式环境，完全有可能在短短几周内学会数百个新单词和语法句型。

intensive.en: Cobalt and Congo are just one example. Getting anything out of the Earth’s crust is an intensive, polluting process, so wouldn’t it be better, the argument goes, for us just to take it from an asteroid?
intensive.zh: 钴和刚果只是一个例子。从地壳中开采任何东西都是一个高耗能、高污染的过程，所以，照此逻辑，我们直接从一颗小行星上获取不是更好吗？

intensive.en: A great English-speaking environment might look something like this: Taking an intensive course which has relatively small classes, regular opportunities to speak, individual feedback from a teacher, and plenty of English outside of the classroom.
intensive.zh: 一个绝佳的英语学习环境可能看起来像这样：参加一个班级相对较小、有定期发言机会、能从老师那里获得个人反馈、并且课外有大量英语输入的高强度课程。

intensive.en: As I’m sure you will know, mining almost anything on Earth, and especially mining precious metals, is a dirty, intensive and expensive activity, often carried out by people, sometimes even children, working in pretty awful conditions.
intensive.zh: 我敢肯定大家都知道，在地球上开采任何东西，尤其是开采贵金属，都是一项肮脏、劳民伤财且昂贵的活动，而且往往是由那些甚至包括儿童在内、在相当恶劣的条件下工作的人来完成的。

instruction.en: The guards had been given a very simple instruction: maintain order in the prison.
instruction.zh: 狱警们得到的指示非常简单：维持监狱秩序。

instruction.en: Trust us. Follow our instructions. The shock generator the teacher was shown looked convincing.
instruction.zh: 相信我们，照我们说的做。“教师”看到的电击发生器，外观十分逼真可信。

instruction.en: The “prisoners,” however, were told to wait at home for further instructions.
instruction.zh: 而“囚犯”们则被告知在家等待进一步通知。

instruction.en: You need good instruction, meaningful communication, regular feedback, and lots of opportunities to actually use English.
instruction.zh: 你需要良好的教学、有意义的交流、定期的反馈，以及大量真正使用英语的机会。

instruction.en: Online learning can also make individualized or personal instruction easier.
instruction.zh: 在线学习还可以使个性化或一对一教学变得更容易。

innocent.en: He may never have personally killed anyone, but he was very far from innocent.
innocent.zh: 他或许从未亲手杀过人，但他远远谈不上无辜。

innocent.en: You are certain you can prove it. And of course, you are innocent.
innocent.zh: 你很确定自己能证明这一点。而且，你当然是无辜的。

innocent.en: Fraud, perhaps, or assault. You maintain that you are innocent.
innocent.zh: 也许是诈骗，或者是人身伤害。你坚称自己是清白的。

innocent.en: He wondered, could ordinary Americans be made to hurt an innocent stranger simply because an authority figure told them to?
innocent.zh: 他不禁想问：普通的美国人，会不会仅仅因为权威人物的一句命令，就去伤害一个无辜的陌生人？

innocent.en: In other words, these bombings were not the work of Chechen terrorists but of the FSB, on Putin’s orders, and hundreds of innocent Russian citizens were murdered to provide justification for a war in Chechnya.
innocent.zh: 换句话说，这些爆炸案不是车臣恐怖分子干的，而是FSB在普京的命令下实施的，数百名无辜的俄罗斯平民被谋杀，仅仅是为了给发动车臣战争提供借口。

insurance.en: National insurance in 1911 only covered workers in regulated employment in specific industries.
insurance.zh: 1911 年的国民保险仅涵盖特定行业中受规管就业的工人。

insurance.en: Insurance companies protected merchants against the risk of shipping.
insurance.zh: 保险公司保护商人免受航运风险。

insurance.en: Then in 1911 came what was called national insurance.
insurance.zh: 然后在 1911 年出台了所谓的国民保险。

insurance.en: They needed banks and insurance companies.
insurance.zh: 它们需要银行和保险公司。

insurance.en: A man who wouldn't have looked out of place teaching at a school, knocking on your door to sell you life insurance, or working in a bookshop.
insurance.zh: 这样一个人，如果他在学校教书、上门推销人寿保险，或者在书店里工作，都不会显得突兀。

incentive.en: After all, for these young men, there was a clear incentive to go to university.
incentive.zh: 毕竟，对于这些年轻人来说，去上大学有明显的动力。

incentive.en: The key seems to be balancing tenant protection with incentives to keep landlords in the market.
incentive.zh: 关键似乎在于平衡租客保护与激励房东留在市场上的动力。

incentive.en: And governments have a strong incentive to stop its value from collapsing.
incentive.zh: 而且政府有强烈的动机去阻止其价值崩盘。

incentive.en: There was no incentive for them to continue, other than because they were told to by the man in the grey coat.
incentive.zh: 他们没有任何继续下去的实际动机，唯一的原因，就是那个穿灰色外套的人叫他们这么做。

incentive.en: As such, he believed in systems, in efficiency, in the idea that human behaviour could be shaped by designing the right incentives.
incentive.zh: 因此，他信仰体制、信仰效率，坚信可以通过设计正确的激励机制来塑造人类行为。

inflict.en: In other words, they did believe they were inflicting real pain, but they did it anyway.
inflict.zh: 换句话说，他们确实相信自己正在造成真实的痛苦，但他们还是做了。

initiative.en: There have been various government initiatives to try to fix this disparity, and reduce the economic gap between north and south.
initiative.zh: 政府曾出台多项举措试图纠正这种不均衡，缩小南北之间的经济差距。

initiative.en: They launch initiatives to help first-time buyers with interest-free loans, but these often end up pushing prices higher by increasing demand.
initiative.zh: 他们推出了通过免息贷款帮助首次购房者的倡议，但这些措施最终往往通过增加需求把房价推得更高。

initiative.en: President Trump could extend DOGE’s mandate with another executive order, and there’s talk of states like Oklahoma and Texas launching their own DOGE-inspired initiatives.
initiative.zh: 特朗普总统可能会通过另一项行政令延长 DOGE 的任期，并且有传言称俄克拉荷马州和德克萨斯州等州正在发起他们自己的受 DOGE 启发的倡议。

initiative.en: In a micro way, it's what we all experience when we are asked to do something we would not do on our own initiative, but we go through with because the organisation we belong to requires it.
initiative.zh: 从微观层面来说，这也是我们每个人都体验过的：被要求去做一件自己不会主动去做的事，却因为所属的组织要求这样做，而最终照做了。

injury.en: Another nine were seriously injured, and the remaining eleven escaped with minor injuries.
injury.zh: 另有九人重伤，其余十一人受轻伤。

injury.en: Doc Holliday was grazed. Wyatt walked away without injury.
injury.zh: Doc Holliday 只是被擦伤，Wyatt 则毫发无损地走了出来。

injury.en: Singapore is majority Chinese. In 1964, racial riots broke out in Singapore between Malay and Chinese communities, resulting in deaths and injuries.
injury.zh: 新加坡是以华人为主的。1964年，新加坡爆发了马来族和华人社群之间的种族骚乱，导致了人员伤亡。

injury.en: She recognized that x-ray technology, which had advanced thanks to her studies of radioactivity, could be used to diagnose injuries or locate bullets and shrapnel inside soldiers’ bodies.
injury.zh: 她认识到，由于她对放射性的研究而取得进展的 X 射线技术可用于诊断受伤情况或定位士兵体内的子弹和弹片。

injury.en: Its inmates were mostly agricultural labourers, men and women who had worked the land their whole lives and had fallen into destitution when work dried up, or when illness or injury made them unable to continue.
injury.zh: 里面的 inmates（院民）大多是农业短工，这些男男女女一生都在耕作土地，当工作枯竭，或者疾病和伤残使他们无以为继时，便陷入了赤贫。

insert.en: He spent much of his later career inserting fake notes and fake documents into early Shakespeare editions, and getting caught doing so.
insert.zh: 他的后半生很大一部分时间都在早期的莎士比亚版本中塞入虚假的笔记和虚假的文件，并因此被抓包。

internal.en: It was Rome that had crippled Carthaginian power and taken advantage of its internal disarray.
internal.zh: 正是罗马削弱了迦太基的实力，并利用其内乱落井下石。

internal.en: Competition between clans increased. Some archeologists believe this period saw rising internal conflict.
internal.zh: 氏族之间的竞争加剧了。一些考古学家认为，这一时期见证了内部冲突的上升。

internal.en: In January 1976, Soilih pushes Jaffar aside in another internal coup.
internal.zh: 1976年1月，Ali Soilih 在另一场内部政变中把 Said Mohamed Jaffar 排挤到了一边。

internal.en: Both of these mechanisms — internal revolts within the governing party, or formal votes in Parliament — mean that a Prime Minister is never entirely secure.
internal.zh: 这两种机制——执政党内部的叛变，或议会中的正式投票——意味着首相永远不会绝对安全。

internal.en: Think about a smartphone. Over time, you might replace the screen as it cracks, upgrade the battery, add a new case, or even change the internal parts.
internal.zh: 想想智能手机。随着时间的推移，你可能会在屏幕破裂时更换它、升级电池、添加新外壳，甚至更换内部零件。

independence.en: Instead, he was about to launch what would become the Turkish War of Independence.
independence.zh: 相反，他即将发起后来被称为土耳其独立战争的运动。

independence.en: I said that 53% voted to stay part of France, which means 47% voted for independence.
independence.zh: 我说过53%的人投票留在法国，这意味着47%的人投票支持独立。

independence.en: In New Caledonia, the population is quite divided over the issue of French independence.
independence.zh: 在新喀里多尼亚，人口在法国独立问题上分歧相当大。

independence.en: He had fought for Turkey’s independence, but now he would fight for its transformation.
independence.zh: 他为土耳其的独立而战，但现在他要为土耳其的转型而战。

independence.en: It no longer needed to rely on Britain. Full legal independence, however, came gradually.
independence.zh: 它不再需要依赖英国。然而，完全的法律独立是一个渐进的过程。

intensify.en: It may well have intensified his fear, agitation and confusion, and triggered further manic episodes.
intensify.zh: 这很可能加剧了他的恐惧、焦虑和困惑，并引发了进一步的躁狂发作。

intensify.en: As air raids intensified, large parts of Berlin were destroyed.
intensify.zh: 随着空袭的加剧，柏林的大片地区被摧毁。

inherit.en: The world he left behind looked almost nothing like the world he had inherited.
inherit.zh: 他留下的世界与他继承的世界几乎毫无相似之处。

inherit.en: Sometimes, the systems we inherit endure not because they are perfect but because they work well enough.
inherit.zh: 有时候，我们继承的系统之所以能够存续，不是因为它们完美，而是因为它们足够好用。

inherit.en: Up next was Rishi Sunak, who inherited a divided Conservative party.
inherit.zh: 接下来是里希·苏纳克（Rishi Sunak），他接手的是一个分裂的保守党。

inherit.en: When the DRC became independent in 1960, it inherited weak institutions.
inherit.zh: 当刚果（金）于1960年独立时，它继承了脆弱的机构。

inherit.en: But he’d inherited a country on its knees.
inherit.zh: 但他接手的是一个跪倒在地的国家。

integrate.en: The Bee Network is an integrated public transport system that combines buses, trams, cycling, and walking.
integrate.zh: 小蜜蜂网络是一个整合了公交、有轨电车、骑行和步行的公共交通系统。

integrate.en: He signs a decree ordering the Presidential Guard to be disarmed and integrated into the regular armed forces.
integrate.zh: 他签署了一项法令，下令缴械总统卫队并将其并入国家正规武装部队。

integrate.en: Six countries, France, West Germany, Italy, Belgium, the Netherlands, and Luxembourg agreed to integrate, to combine, their coal and steel industries.
integrate.zh: 六个国家——法国、西德、意大利、比利时、荷兰和卢森堡——同意整合并合并他们的煤炭和钢铁工业。

integrate.en: A third reason is public trust. Governments want voters to believe that new immigrants will be able to contribute and communicate and integrate into society.
integrate.zh: 第三个原因是公众信任。政府希望选民相信，新移民将能够为社会做出贡献、进行沟通并融入社会。

integrate.en: Clearly, these issues were not solved, as Prigozhin died in a plane crash a few months later, and what this has meant, according to many Russia watchers, is that Wagner has more closely integrated with the regular Russian forces.
integrate.zh: 显然，这些问题并没有解决，因为普里戈津几个月后在一次坠机事故中身亡，据许多俄罗斯问题观察家称，这意味着瓦格纳已经更紧密地融入了俄罗斯正规军。

invade.en: Japan had invaded British-controlled Malaya from the north and advanced down the peninsula.
invade.zh: 日本从北部入侵了英国控制的马来亚，并向半岛推进。

invade.en: For example, after Iraq invaded Kuwait in 1990, the Security Council passed strong resolutions demanding withdrawal.
invade.zh: 例如，在1990年伊拉克入侵科威特之后，安理会通过了强烈要求其撤军的决议。

invade.en: Then in the 1860s, Mexico was invaded by France.
invade.zh: 然后在19世纪60年代，墨西哥遭到法国入侵。

invade.en: Now, Henry had no interest in invading Ireland himself.
invade.zh: 当时，Henry 本人对入侵爱尔兰并无兴趣。

invade.en: And then, in September 1939, Germany invaded Poland.
invade.zh: 接着，在 1939 年 9 月，德国入侵了波兰。

instability.en: Countries that don’t do this will be trapped in cycles of dependence and instability.
instability.zh: 不这样做的国家将陷入依赖与动荡的循环之中。

instability.en: David Cameron, whose resignation began this period of instability, was prime minister for six years.
instability.zh: 大卫·卡梅伦（David Cameron），正是他的辞职开启了这段动荡时期，他担任了6年首相。

instability.en: Can Andy Burnham change this? Or is political instability now normal in Britain?
instability.zh: Andy Burnham能改变这一切吗？还是说政治不稳定现在成了英国的新常态？

instability.en: Large parts of the DRC have experienced decades of violence and political instability.
instability.zh: 刚果（金）的大片地区经历了数十年的暴力和政治动荡。

instability.en: There was economic pressure, political instability, nationalism, and a fear of an external threat.
instability.zh: 当时存在经济压力、政治不稳定、民族主义以及对外部威胁的恐惧。

indication.en: Sure, it was New Year’s Eve, and everyone had had a few drinks, but there was no indication that he was particularly drunk or disorderly, nobody remembered him causing any problems.
indication.zh: 没错，那天是除夕夜，大家都喝了点酒，但没有迹象表明他特别醉或者行为失控，也没有人记得他惹出过什么麻烦。

indication.en: As you may remember, this was in 2008, and at the time, there was reportedly a popular joke being told by Russians that gives you some indication of who people thought was really in charge.
indication.zh: 你可能还记得，那是2008年，当时据报道俄罗斯流传着一个笑话，能让你大致看出人们认为究竟是谁在掌权。

incident.en: In 2007, Blackwater contractors were involved in an incident that became infamous: the Nisour Square massacre in Baghdad.
incident.zh: 2007年，黑水公司的承包商卷入了一起臭名昭著的事件：巴格达尼苏尔广场屠杀事件（Nisour Square massacre）。

incident.en: And then, in June 2017, a year and a half after the incident, the North Korean government made a surprise announcement.
incident.zh: 然后，在2017年6月，也就是事发一年半之后，朝鲜政府突然发布了一项声明。

incident.en: One of the most famous incidents happened in 1773.
incident.zh: 最著名的事件之一发生在1773年。

incident.en: These incidents not only silence critics but also serve as a warning to others: defy the Kremlin at your own risk.
incident.zh: 这些事件不仅让批评者闭嘴，也对其他人起到了警示作用：挑战克里姆林宫，后果自负。

incident.en: One of the most infamous incidents involves a video of Wagner operatives allegedly using a sledgehammer to execute a Syrian prisoner.
incident.zh: 其中最臭名昭著的事件涉及一段视频，内容据称是瓦格纳特工使用大锤处决一名叙利亚囚犯。

inaugurate.en: As Donald Trump was inaugurated as the president of the USA in January, the people sat right behind him, in front of the world’s media, in the best seats, were tech billionaires.
inaugurate.zh: 1月唐纳德·特朗普就任美国总统时，坐在他身后、面对全球媒体、坐在最好位置上的人正是科技亿万富翁们。

inaugurate.en: The Warmbiers knew that Donald Trump was a keen watcher of Fox News, and thought that if they could go on the show and tell their story, it might appeal to the one viewer who could do something about it: the then relatively recently inaugurated President Trump.
inaugurate.zh: 瓦姆比尔一家知道唐纳德·特朗普是福克斯新闻(Fox News)的忠实观众，他们觉得，如果能上那个节目讲述自己的遭遇，或许能打动那位唯一有能力采取行动的观众——那位刚刚上任不久的特朗普总统。

inaugurate.en: And, on the Republican side, it is an interesting time to talk about the role of the Vice President because when Donald Trump is inaugurated, on January 20th 2025, he will be 78 years and 220 days old, half a year older than Joe Biden was at his inauguration.
inaugurate.zh: 而在共和党这边，讨论副总统这个角色也正当其时，因为当唐纳德·特朗普于2025年1月20日就职时，他将年满78岁零220天，比乔·拜登就职时还要大半岁。

inaugurate.en: Now, before we get to the question of how much waste and inefficiency there is thought to have been, and some theories about the motivations behind the organisation set up to combat it, we must go back to the start, to well before January 20th, the day that Donald Trump was inaugurated for his second term.
inaugurate.zh: 现在，在我们探讨人们认为存在多少浪费和低效，以及关于为打击这些现象而设立的组织的动机的一些理论之前，我们必须回到最初，回到 1 月 20 日（唐纳德·特朗普宣誓就职第二任期的日子）之前很久。

inflation.en: There were food shortages, strict rationing and inflation that affected millions of civilians.
inflation.zh: 出现了粮食短缺、严格的配给制和通货膨胀，影响了数百万平民。

inflation.en: Inflation soared, debt piled up, and the state became little more than an empty shell.
inflation.zh: 通货膨胀飙升，债务堆积如山，国家沦空壳一个。

inflation.en: Decisions made by oil-producing countries affect inflation, transportation, food prices, and our everyday lives.
inflation.zh: 产油国做出的决定会影响通货膨胀、交通运输、食品价格以及我们的日常生活。

inflation.en: But for many ordinary workers, wages are relatively stagnant, especially when you adjust it for inflation.
inflation.zh: 但对许多普通工人来说，工资相对停滞不前，特别是当你根据通货膨胀进行调整时。

inflation.en: Things like inflation, rising house prices and the cost of living continues to rise around the world.
inflation.zh: 通货膨胀、不断上涨的房价和生活成本继续在全球范围内上升。

input.en: So, let’s start with input: reading first, and then listening.
input.zh: 所以，让我们从输入开始：先是阅读，然后是听力。

input.en: The accents are better, it sounds more natural, and most importantly, it gives you 24/7 access to an endlessly patient and friendly source of English input.
input.zh: 口音更好了，听起来更自然，最重要的是，它为你提供了全天候的无限耐心且友好的英语输入来源。

interrupt.en: Instead of interrupting or disagreeing, you can use questions to bring the focus back.
interrupt.zh: 与其打断或表示反对，你可以用问题把焦点拉回来。

interrupt.en: I make a lot of mistakes, but I don’t let that interrupt my conversations.
interrupt.zh: 我犯了很多错误，但我不会让错误打断我的对话。

interrupt.en: You can even interrupt it mid-sentence and ask it for clarification.
interrupt.zh: 你甚至可以在句子中途打断它并要求它澄清。

interrupt.en: Instead of interrupting or disagreeing directly, a well-timed question can gently bring the conversation back to the main point.
interrupt.zh: 与其直接打断或表示反对，一个切入时机恰当的问题可以温和地把对话拉回正题。

interrupt.en: It’s not the English that you’ll find in the real world, English that’s full of ums and ahs, people changing what they want to say mid-sentence, mumbling, being interrupted, real, raw, native English.
interrupt.zh: 这不是你在现实世界中会遇到的英语，现实世界中的英语充满了嗯和啊、人们在句子中途改变想说的话、嘟囔、被打断，这是真实、生动、地道的英语。

infinitely.en: When you talk to an AI, it is infinitely patient.
infinitely.zh: 当你与人工智能交谈时，它是无限耐心的。

infinitely.en: Today, where technology is infinitely more entrenched in every aspect of our lives than 50 years ago, his anti-technology message is able to spread ever further and faster, and is reaching more people than ever before.
infinitely.zh: 今天，科技比 50 年前更深地融入了我们生活的方方面面，他的反科技信息得以传得更远、更快，正触及比以往任何时候都多的人。

infinitely.en: And I have to admit that I am infinitely more impressed with those people who haven’t, the people who have forced themselves to produce English, even when there is the tempting option of getting an AI tool to write it for you.
infinitely.zh: 我必须承认，我对那些没有使用人工智能的人、那些强迫自己产出英语的人（即使有让人工智能替你写的诱人选项）抱有无限的敬意。

invisible.en: To the Puritans, the invisible world was just as real as the frozen ponds outside.
invisible.zh: 在清教徒看来，无形的世界和外面结冰的池塘一样真实。

invisible.en: Of course, it wasn’t reliable; it was invisible and was one person’s word against another's.
invisible.zh: 当然，这本就不可靠；它虚无缥缈，而且完全是各执一词。

invisible.en: To the authorities, the Unabomber was not simply dangerous; he was invisible.
invisible.zh: 在当局看来，The Unabomber 不仅危险，而且隐形。

invisible.en: Their income is unstable, unpredictable, and often invisible in official statistics.
invisible.zh: 他们的收入不稳定、不可预测，并且在官方统计中往往是隐形的。

invisible.en: In forests, they tracked prey invisible to the human eye.
invisible.zh: 在森林里，它们追踪人眼无法察觉的猎物。

insidious.en: And this brings us to one of the most insidious effects: housing wealth is becoming hereditary.
insidious.zh: 这就给我们带来了最阴险的影响之一：住房财富正在变成世袭的。

indefinitely.en: Nuclear reactors, if well-designed, could run almost indefinitely without interruption, providing a consistent, stable source of energy.
indefinitely.zh: 如果设计得当，核反应堆几乎可以无限期地连续运行，提供源源不断、稳定可靠的能源。

indefinitely.en: But crucially, it cannot block legislation indefinitely, forever.
indefinitely.zh: 但至关重要的是，它不能无限期地阻止立法。

indefinitely.en: Can house prices keep rising faster than incomes indefinitely?
indefinitely.zh: 房价能无限期地以快于收入的速度继续上涨吗？

insight.en: I think perhaps the most important insight I gained was how necessity accelerates learning.
insight.zh: 我想我得到的最大感悟或许是需求如何加速学习。

insight.en: But they were important. They gave him insight into how decisions were made.
insight.zh: 但它们很重要。这让他深入了解了决策是如何做出的。

insight.en: Turing’s most powerful insight was the idea of a universal machine.
insight.zh: Turing 最具威力的洞察是通用机的概念。

instinctively.en: You can notice patterns. You learn vocabulary, and you can recognize the grammar instinctively.
instinctively.zh: 你可以注意到规律。你学会了词汇，并且能够本能地识别语法。

instinctively.en: MBS understood this instinctively. He also believed that his country needed to change.
instinctively.zh: MBS本能地理解这一点。他也坚信自己的国家必须做出改变。

instinctively.en: He instinctively knows the rhythm, structure, tone, and energy of the track without needing to think.
instinctively.zh: 他无需思考，就能本能地知道该曲目的节奏、结构、音调和能量。

influential.en: More than 500 years after his death, Leonardo da Vinci continues to be influential today.
influential.zh: 在逝世五百多年后的今天，列奥纳多·达·芬奇依然具有影响力。

influential.en: They donate money to politicians. They are on friendly terms with influential government figures.
influential.zh: 他们向政治家捐款。他们与有影响力的政府人物保持着友好的关系。

influential.en: The reason why OPEC is so influential is the principle of supply and demand.
influential.zh: OPEC之所以如此具有影响力，是因为供求规律。

influential.en: But the UAE is the most influential or the largest country to do so recently.
influential.zh: 但阿联酋是近期采取这一行动的最具影响力或规模最大的国家。

influential.en: One of the most influential thinkers for the American colonists was John Locke.
influential.zh: 对美洲殖民地居民最具影响力的思想家之一是约翰·洛克。

investigation.en: Footage recorded on the street or at stations can be reviewed later in police investigations.
investigation.zh: 在街上或车站录下的画面可以在随后的警方调查中进行审查。

investigation.en: In 2015, US and Swiss authorities launched a major investigation into FIFA and into FIFA officials.
investigation.zh: 2015年，美国和瑞士当局对国际足联及国际足联官员展开了一场重大调查。

investigation.en: Investigations also revealed corruption in the selection process for the 2018 and the 2022 World Cups.
investigation.zh: 调查还揭露了2018年和2022年世界杯举办地选择过程中的腐败行为。

investigation.en: Another important function is collecting evidence in investigations.
investigation.zh: 另一个重要的功能是在调查中收集证据。

investigation.en: A 1992 investigation accused Putin of allowing raw materials—like metals—to be sold abroad in exchange for food imports that never arrived.
investigation.zh: 1992年的一项调查指控Putin允许将金属等原材料出售到国外，以换取永远没有送到的食品进口。

inaccurate.en: And to be fair, that’s not an entirely inaccurate summary.
inaccurate.zh: 平心而论，这个总结并不完全不准确。

insist.en: And when he was finally apprehended in Australia, he insisted that he'd done nothing wrong.
insist.zh: 当他最终在澳大利亚被捕时，他坚称自己没做错任何事。

insist.en: If the elected House of Commons insists, its decision ultimately wins.
insist.zh: 如果民选的下议院坚持，它的决定最终会获胜。

insist.en: Warning signs appear. And leaders insist conflict can be avoided.
insist.zh: 警告信号出现了。而领导人们坚称冲突是可以避免的。

insist.en: At first, von Stauffenberg insisted, “I saw the explosion.
insist.zh: 起初，冯·施陶芬贝格坚称：“我看到了爆炸。

insist.en: Morsi dug his heels, insisting he was the legitimate president, elected by the people, which of course, technically he was.
insist.zh: Morsi 固执己见，坚称自己是合法总统，由人民选出，当然从技术上讲他确实是。

incompatible.en: The anonymous author—who signed his letters as “FC”, short for Freedom Club—he believed that modern technological society was not simply flawed, but fundamentally incompatible with human freedom.
incompatible.zh: 这位匿名作者——他在信中署名“FC”，即自由俱乐部（Freedom Club）的缩写——他认为现代技术社会不仅有瑕疵，而且与人类的自由根本水火不容。

intelligent.en: You must be really intelligent,” you’re saying to a student that their ability is fixed.
intelligent.zh: 你一定很聪明，”你就是在对学生说他们的能力是固定的。

intelligent.en: He was off-the-charts intelligent. By the age of six, Ted was doing complex arithmetic in his head.
intelligent.zh: 他的智商高得离谱。六岁时，泰德就能在脑海里做复杂的算术。

intelligent.en: He was charismatic, spoke several languages, fiercely intelligent, and was effectively Lumumba’s trusted right hand man and confidant.
intelligent.zh: 他极具个人魅力，精通数门语言，聪明绝顶，实际上是卢蒙巴最信任的得力助手和知己。

intelligent.en: If the judge cannot reliably tell the machine from the human, then the machine is said to demonstrate intelligent behavior.
intelligent.zh: 如果裁判无法可靠地分辨出哪个是机器、哪个是人，那么这台机器就被认为展现出了智能行为。

intelligent.en: It is the feeling that you’re not good enough, you’re not intelligent enough, you’re not skilled enough to handle a situation.
intelligent.zh: 那是这样一种感觉：觉得自己不够优秀、不够聪明、技能不够，无法应付某种局面。

initially.en: Now, this movement was initially very popular in the Congo, or Zaire as it was then.
initially.zh: 最初，这场运动在刚果（当时的扎伊尔）非常受欢迎。

initially.en: Initially, tulips were just a simple luxury flower for gardens, but speculation soon took over.
initially.zh: 最初，郁金香只是花园里一种简单的奢侈花卉，但投机很快占了上风。

initially.en: Initially, they were focused on individual industries, but they quickly spread.
initially.zh: 最初，这些法律针对的是个别行业，但很快就普及开来。

initially.en: Now, when the FBI received the tip, they were initially skeptical.
initially.zh: 现在，当 FBI 收到这条线索时，他们起初是持怀疑态度的。

initially.en: Initially, these British industries were supported financially by the government.
initially.zh: 起初，这些英国产业得到了政府的财政支持。

insanity.en: They wanted him to plead "not guilty by reason of insanity."
insanity.zh: 他们希望他以“精神失常导致无罪”进行抗辩。

insanity.en: In the immediate aftermath, there were movements to try to undo some of the damage, or at least acknowledge the sheer insanity of it.
insanity.zh: 在那之后的短期内，出现了一些试图弥补部分损失的行动，或者至少承认了那种彻头彻尾的疯狂。

insane.en: The most famous example is one that you might be surprised hasn’t come up yet: that he “made his favourite horse a senator”, and this is an example of how insane he was.
insane.zh: 最著名的例子你可能感到惊讶，到现在还没出现：那就是他“把他最喜欢的马封为参议员”，这成了他如何疯狂的例证。

insane.en: To be declared insane would invalidate his manifesto and his entire political philosophy, and the entire reason he had embarked on his bombing campaign was for his views to be taken seriously.
insane.zh: 被宣布为精神失常将使他的宣言和他的整个政治哲学化为乌有，而他之所以踏上炸弹袭击之路，其全部原因就是为了让自己的观点被严肃对待。

interface.en: Well, most probably not. Software development might not exist in exactly the same way, and the probability of someone typing “create a signup form” into a text interface seems…slim.
interface.zh: 很可能不会了。软件开发到时候的形态，大概率已经和现在不完全一样，到那时还有人在文本界面里敲“帮我做一个注册表单”这种指令的概率……似乎不高。

interface.en: By personal AI use, I mean an individual, you or me, or any of the other hundreds of millions of people using ChatGPT or other AI tools, and going into the interface and asking a question.
interface.zh: 我所说的个人人工智能使用，是指个人（你我，或者使用 ChatGPT 或其他 AI 工具的其他数亿人中的任何一个）进入界面并提出问题。

inherent.en: This is part of the reason technology companies are busy pledging to switch to cleaner energy sources —not necessarily because they have some inherent love for the environment, but because the cleaner the energy used in their data centres, the less ammunition environmental critics have against them.
inherent.zh: 这也是科技公司忙于承诺转向清洁能源的部分原因——不一定是因为它们天生热爱环境，而是因为数据中心使用的能源越清洁，环保批评者针对它们的弹药就越少。

interim.en: Tanks rolled into Cairo, President Morsi was arrested, and an interim government was set up.
interim.zh: 坦克驶入开罗，Morsi 总统被捕，过渡政府宣告成立。

interim.en: The next part was, comparatively, easy: mobilise the emergency “continuity of government” plan, appoint an interim successor, and most probably seek peace with the Allies.
interim.zh: 接下来的一部分相对来说就容易了：启动紧急“政府延续”计划，任命一个临时接班人，并且极有可能是向盟军寻求和平。

inspect.en: But he survived. In the immediate aftermath of the event, he could be seen wandering around the rubble, inspecting the chaos.
inspect.zh: 但他活了下来。事件发生后不久，人们可以看到他在废墟中四处徘徊，查看混乱的现场。

intellectual.en: The Renaissance was a time of cultural and intellectual change in Europe.
intellectual.zh: 文艺复兴是欧洲文化和思想变革的时期。

intellectual.en: The revolution was a complex conflict involving peasants, workers, rebels, and intellectuals, all demanding change.
intellectual.zh: 这场革命是一场复杂的冲突，涉及农民、工人、叛军和知识分子，所有人都要求变革。

intellectual.en: The Enlightenment was an intellectual movement that encouraged people to use reason and evidence to understand the world.
intellectual.zh: 启蒙运动是一场鼓励人们运用理性和证据来理解世界的思想运动。

intellectual.en: Government institutions expanded, industry in the city grew faster, and the city, Berlin, attracted officials and intellectuals, artists and entrepreneurs.
intellectual.zh: 政府机构扩大了，城市中的工业增长更快，柏林这座城市吸引了官员、知识分子、艺术家和企业家。

intellectual.en: He expanded Prussia’s territory, strengthened its army, and promoted some ideas from the Enlightenment, such as education, more religious tolerance, and more intellectual debate.
intellectual.zh: 他扩张了普鲁士的领土，加强了军队，并推广了一些启蒙运动的思想，例如教育、更多的宗教宽容和更多的知识辩论。

inventory.en: It was a moderate success. It never made much money, but it did teach the then 26-year-old some boring but important skills: things like inventory management, pricing, customer service, and the basics of running an online business.
inventory.zh: 这算得上是小有成功。它虽然没赚到什么大钱，但确实让当时 26 岁的他学到了一些枯燥却重要的技能：比如库存管理、定价、客户服务以及运营在线业务的基本知识。

interference.en: They resented Roman taxes, Roman military conscription, and Roman interference in local affairs.
interference.zh: 他们痛恨罗马的税收、罗马的兵役以及罗马对地方事务的干涉。

interference.en: Beyond communication, code switching can lead to interference between languages.
interference.zh: 除了沟通，语码转换还会导致语言之间的干扰。

interference.en: In the deserts of Arabia, tribal leaders held enormous power, often ruling over their lands with little direct interference from Constantinople.
interference.zh: 在阿拉伯沙漠中，部落领袖拥有巨大的权力，通常统治着自己的土地，很少受到来自君士坦丁堡的直接干预。

interference.en: In other words, the most efficient system is one where individuals are left to do what they want, without any state interference.
interference.zh: 换句话说，最有效的系统就是让个人自由地做他们想做的事，不受任何国家干预。

interference.en: The Austrian School of economics argues, essentially, that the most effective economic system is one based on free markets and voluntary exchange, with minimal government interference.
interference.zh: 奥地利学派经济学实质上认为，最有效的经济体系是建立在自由市场和自愿交换基础上的体系，政府干预应降到最低。

intent.en: Vague prompts lead to vague results. When you ask someone a good question, you are clear about your intent.
intent.zh: 模糊的提示词会导致模糊的结果。当你向某人提出一个好问题时，你的意图是很清晰的。

intent.en: Now, I should add that these killings didn’t take place; it seemed that he'd been scammed, but the prosecution alleged that the intent was there.
intent.zh: 在这里我应该补充一下，这些谋杀并没有实际发生，他似乎是被骗了，但检方指控他确实有此意图。

incorporate.en: This isn’t unusual. Most countries around the world have incorporated foods introduced by immigrants.
incorporate.zh: 这并不罕见。世界上大多数国家都融入了由移民引入的食物。

incorporate.en: Force yourself to just use English. Maybe incorporate English only sessions into your daily life.
incorporate.zh: 强迫自己只使用英语。也许可以将纯英语时段融入你的日常生活中。

incorporate.en: We will, most probably, introduce some shorter episodes, and there are lots of more specific pieces of feedback that I’ll definitely be incorporating into the show, but these are just a few examples of how you can’t please everyone, and sometimes how you have to just do what feels right…
incorporate.zh: 我们极有可能推出一些较短的节目，还有很多具体的反馈我肯定会采纳到节目中，但这些例子说明了你无法取悦所有人，有时你只能做你觉得正确的事情……

inclusive.en: And while supporters framed this reform as modern, inclusive, and pragmatic, opponents presented it as rushed, dangerous, and as something that could erode and dilute Italian identity.
inclusive.zh: 虽然支持者将这场改革描绘成现代、包容和务实的，但反对者却将其视为仓促、危险的举动，并认为这可能会侵蚀和稀释意大利人的身份认同。

inclusive.en: France, for its part, has long operated under a more inclusive model, with automatic or semi-automatic citizenship for children born in France to foreign parents who have lived in the country.
inclusive.zh: 至于法国，长期以来一直奉行更具包容性的模式，对在法国出生且父母长期居住在该国的外国儿童自动或半自动授予国籍。

infrastructure.en: These bribes were paid so that Siemens would then be given contracts for infrastructure projects.
infrastructure.zh: 支付这些贿赂是为了让西门子能够获得基础设施建设项目的合同。

infrastructure.en: But the country cannot use this infrastructure or technology fully if they stay in OPEC.
infrastructure.zh: 但如果留在OPEC，该国就无法充分利用这些基础设施或技术。

infrastructure.en: There was practically no infrastructure, no way of getting from one castle to the next.
infrastructure.zh: 那里几乎没有基础设施，没有从一座城堡到下一座城堡的交通方式。

infrastructure.en: Different governments have invested their diamond revenues into infrastructure and healthcare and education.
infrastructure.zh: 不同的政府将钻石收入投资于基础设施、医疗保健和教育。

infrastructure.en: In the United States, too, the government invested heavily in nuclear infrastructure.
infrastructure.zh: 在美国，政府同样在核基础设施上投入了巨资。

inevitable.en: This was a secret deal signed in 1916, the Sykes-Picot Agreement, in which the British and the French carved up the region after the inevitable fall of the Ottoman Empire.
inevitable.zh: 这是 1916 年签署的一项秘密协议，即 Sykes-Picot Agreement，英国和法国在其中瓜分了奥斯曼帝国必然垮台后的该地区。

incapable.en: But this doesn’t mean that adults are incapable of becoming highly proficient.
incapable.zh: 但这并不意味着成年人就无法变得高度精通。

incapable.en: Many young officers, including Mustafa Kemal, started to realise that the Ottoman system was outdated, corrupt, and incapable of modernising.
incapable.zh: 许多年轻军官，包括穆斯塔法·凯末尔，开始意识到奥斯曼体系已经过时、腐败且无力实现现代化。

intact.en: His first mission was in 1906, and he amazed everyone by returning intact and a year ahead of schedule.
intact.zh: 他的第一次任务是在 1906 年，他毫发无伤地归来，并且比预定时间提前了一年，这让所有人惊叹不已。

intermittent.en: For a while, all went well. Fawcett sent intermittent updates via runners who carried letters back to the edges of the jungle, where telegraphs could relay his words to the wider world.
intermittent.zh: 有一段时间，一切都很顺利。Fawcett 通过信使断断续续地发回消息，信使将信件带到丛林边缘，再由电报将他的话语传送到更广阔的世界。

invoice.en: Everyone would be far better off if they pretended to fight a little, and they could return to their masters with a large invoice and the prospect of more work to come.
invoice.zh: 如果大家都假装打一会儿，然后带着一大笔账单和未来更多工作的希望回到各自的主子身边，那么对所有人来说都会好得多。

intersection.en: During a security mission, Blackwater guards opened fire on a crowded intersection, killing 17 Iraqi civilians and injuring many more.
intersection.zh: 在一次安保任务中，黑水公司的警卫向一个拥挤的十字路口开枪，造成17名伊拉克平民死亡，多人受伤。

intersection.en: When an instructor said something like, “stop at the intersection”, or “please parallel park”, I was expected to follow instructions immediately, of course.
intersection.zh: 当教练说出诸如“在路口停车”或“请侧方停车”之类的话时，我当然必须立即执行指令。

intriguing.en: The ancient society existed in what is now Pakistan and Northwest India, and is probably one of history’s most intriguing mysteries.
intriguing.zh: 这个古代社会存在于现在的巴基斯坦和印度西北部，可能是历史上最令人着迷的谜团之一。

intriguing.en: Another intriguing idea is the World Calendar, which divides the year into 12 months, but the focus is on quarters–blocks of three months–rather than individual months.
intriguing.zh: 另一个有趣的观点是世界日历，它将一年划分为 12 个月，但重点是季度——三个月的区块——而不是单个月份。

ingenuity.en: But when you stop to consider them, they’re an incredible testament to human ingenuity.
ingenuity.zh: 但当你停下来思考它们时，它们是人类创造力的不可思议的证明。

indiscriminately.en: The Russian military indiscriminately bombed Chechen cities, including Grozny, the capital, which was described by the United Nations as the most destroyed city on Earth at the time.
indiscriminately.zh: 俄罗斯军队无差别地轰炸车臣城市，包括首都格罗兹尼，被联合国形容为当时地球上被毁得最严重的城市。

insignificant.en: This was famously summed up by the first Vice President, John Adams, who is reported to have said that the Vice Presidency was “the most insignificant office that ever the invention of man contrived.”
insignificant.zh: 首任副总统John Adams对此曾有过一句名言，据报道他说副总统是“人类发明过的最微不足道的职位”。

instant.en: Cities destroyed in an instant, tens, if not hundreds of thousands dead.
instant.zh: 城市瞬间被毁，成千上万甚至数十万人丧生。

instant.en: The post-war decades saw the growth of processed food and convenience food: frozen vegetables, canned food, instant meals, microwave meals.
instant.zh: 战后的几十年见证了加工食品和便利食品的增长：冷冻蔬菜、罐头食品、即食食品、微波炉加热食品。

interruption.en: Nuclear reactors, if well-designed, could run almost indefinitely without interruption, providing a consistent, stable source of energy.
interruption.zh: 如果设计得当，核反应堆几乎可以无限期地连续运行，提供源源不断、稳定可靠的能源。

inhabitant.en: Today, Rapa Nui is home to around 8,000 people, many of whom are descendants of the original inhabitants.
inhabitant.zh: 如今，Rapa Nui 居住着大约8000人，其中许多人都是最初居民的后代。

inhabitant.en: Clearly, there was an abundance of life beneath the surface, but compared to the life on earth, the ocean, and its inhabitants, were very poorly understood.
inhabitant.zh: 很明显，水面之下有着丰富的生命，但与陆地上的生命相比，海洋及其居民受到的了解却非常少。

inhabitant.en: Many long-term inhabitants, often the descendants of the original Chinese and Malay laborers, were forcibly repatriated, forcibly deported, to Singapore or Malaysia or China.
inhabitant.zh: 许多长期居民，通常是中国和马来西亚原住民劳工的后代，被强行遣返，强行驱逐出境到新加坡、马来西亚或中国。

inventor.en: Who was Leonardo da Vinci? He was an artist, an inventor, and a thinker.
inventor.zh: 列奥纳多·达·芬奇是谁？他是一位艺术家、发明家和思想家。

inventor.en: He was also a scientist, an engineer, an anatomist, and an inventor.
inventor.zh: 他同时也是一位科学家、工程师、解剖学家和发明家。

inventor.en: The next important step came a century and a half later, during the American war of independence, when an American inventor called David Bushnell created the “Turtle”.
inventor.zh: 下一个重要步骤发生在一个半世纪后，即美国独立战争期间，当时一位名叫大卫·布什内尔（David Bushnell）的美国发明家创造了“海龟号”（Turtle）。

inventor.en: But in 1620, just under 100 years after de Lorena and De Marchi’s trip to the bottom of Lake Nemi, a Dutch inventor named Cornelis Drebbel would design something that would go on to surpass the diving bell: the submarine.
inventor.zh: 但在1620年，就在德洛雷纳和德马基内米湖之行不到100年后，一位名叫科内利斯·德雷贝尔（Cornelis Drebbel）的荷兰发明家设计出了一种将超越潜水钟的东西：潜艇。

innate.en: And this genetic similarity gives them an innate talent for sprinting.
innate.zh: 正是这种基因相似性赋予了他们短跑的先天天赋。

innate.en: It is your natural, innate qualities that give you a head start.
innate.zh: 它是你天生具备的、能让你占得先机的特质。

innate.en: It’s based on their innate talent, when the reality is they have worked hard to develop that skill.
innate.zh: 这是建立在他们的先天才能之上的，而现实情况是他们为了培养这项技能付出了努力。

innate.en: And they weren’t doing this only out of scientific curiosity, or out of an innate desire to understand the marine biology of the seas.
innate.zh: 他们这样做不仅仅是出于对科学的好奇，也不是出于对了解海洋生物学的内在渴望。

invaluable.en: If they got him young, then by the time he was at the top he would be an invaluable asset.
invaluable.zh: 如果趁他年轻时就拉拢他，那么等他登上高位时，他将成为一笔无价的资产。

inadequate.en: The seat of political power is London, and people in the North often complain that politicians in Westminster do not care about them and that there is inadequate investment in the north of England.
inadequate.zh: 政治权力的中心在伦敦，北方人经常抱怨威斯敏斯特的政客不关心他们，而且对英格兰北部的投资严重不足。

incidentally.en: In Blackpool, which is incidentally where my father was born, the life expectancy at birth is 73, but in Cambridgeshire, in the southeast, it is 83.
incidentally.zh: 在黑池（顺便提一句，那是我父亲出生的地方），出生时的预期寿命是73岁，而在东南部的剑桥郡，这一数字是83岁。

inspiration.en: The foods might have South Asian roots and inspiration, but they are uniquely found in Britain.
inspiration.zh: 这些食物可能源于南亚并受到其启发，但它们是英国独有的。

inspiration.en: He also claimed that his inspiration came directly from his family’s goddess Namagiri, who revealed the formulas to him in dreams.
inspiration.zh: 他还声称自己的灵感直接来自于他家族的女神纳玛吉里（Namagiri），女神在梦中向他显现了这些公式。

inspiration.en: The Beagle voyage provided the observations, the evidence, and the inspiration that would eventually lead Darwin to the revolutionary Theory of Evolution.
inspiration.zh: Beagle号的航行为Darwin提供了最终带来革命性进化论的观察结果、证据和灵感。

inefficient.en: Interviewing every single applicant individually would be a very inefficient way to test English ability.
inefficient.zh: 单独面试每一位申请人，将是测试英语能力的一种极其低效的方法。

inhabit.en: The closest inhabited island to Easter Island is Pitcairn Island, which is more than 2000 kilometers away.
inhabit.zh: 距离复活节岛最近的有人居住的岛屿是皮特凯恩岛，距离超过2000公里。

inhabit.en: It was a perfect place to live. When Europeans arrived in the early 16th century, the area was already inhabited by indigenous peoples.
inhabit.zh: 这是一个绝佳的居住地。当欧洲人在16世纪初抵达时，该地区已经有土著居民居住。

inhabit.en: Easter Island is in the middle of the Pacific Ocean, one of the most isolated inhabited islands on Earth, and home to hundreds of giant stone heads.
inhabit.zh: 复活节岛位于太平洋中部，是地球上最孤立的有人居住的岛屿之一，也是数百尊巨型石像的故乡。

interconnect.en: Because Canada shares a long border with the United States, the two countries’ economies are interconnected.
interconnect.zh: 由于加拿大与美国共享漫长的边境线，两国的经济是紧密相连的。

intermediate.en: And I won the beginner or the lower intermediate category in the speech contest.
intermediate.zh: 我在演讲比赛中获得了初级或中初级组的冠军。

intermediate.en: And then one year later, I passed N3, which is intermediate Japanese.
intermediate.zh: 一年后，我通过了N3，也就是日语中级。

intermediate.en: So basically an increase from intermediate English to upper intermediate.
intermediate.zh: 所以基本上是从中级英语提高到中高级。

intermediate.en: So basically an increase from intermediate English to upper intermediate.
intermediate.zh: 所以基本上是从中级英语提高到中高级。

ink.en: One common method was woodblock printing, where entire pages of text were carved into wooden blocks, covered with ink, and pressed onto paper.
ink.zh: 常见的一种方法是雕版印刷，即把整页文字雕刻在木板上，涂上墨水，然后压印到纸上。

installment.en: Readers would then wait for the next installment.
installment.zh: 读者们则会等待下一期的更新。

invitation.en: You are invited to a party. The invitation says the party starts at 8:00 PM.
invitation.zh: 你受邀去参加一个派对。邀请函上写着派对在晚上8:00开始。

invitation.en: In his later years, Leonardo accepted an invitation from Francis I of France and moved to France.
invitation.zh: 晚年时，列奥纳多接受了法国国王弗朗索瓦一世的邀请移居法国。

invitation.en: When he was 22 years old, Charles Darwin received an invitation to join a global expedition aboard a British Navy ship called HMS Beagle.
invitation.zh: 22岁时，Charles Darwin收到了一份邀请，登上了一艘名为HMS Beagle的英国海军舰艇，参与环球考察。

invitation.en: You are invited to a party. The invitation says the party starts at 20:00.
invitation.zh: 你受邀去参加一个派对，邀请函上写着派对在晚上八点开始。

indefinite.en: Importantly, time alone will no longer be enough to qualify for indefinite leave to remain.
indefinite.zh: 重要的是，单靠时间将不再足以满足获得无限期留居许可的条件。

indefinite.en: Indefinite Leave to Remain means that you can live in the UK permanently.
indefinite.zh: Indefinite Leave to Remain 意味着你可以在英国永久居住。

infinite.en: These are equations that add together an endless or infinite number of terms.
infinite.zh: 这些方程将无限或无数个项相加在一起。

infinite.en: Another contribution was his work on infinite series.
infinite.zh: 另一个贡献是他对级数的研究。

infinite.en: It existed only as an idea. Turing imagined a very long strip of paper, like an infinite roll of tape, that was divided into squares.
infinite.zh: 它仅以概念的形式存在。Turing 想象了一条很长的纸带，就像卷无限长的磁带一样，上面被划分为一个个方格。

incomplete.en: Without Darwin, our understanding of life on earth would be incomplete.
incomplete.zh: 没有Darwin，我们对地球生命的理解将是不完整的。

incomplete.en: While many experts now criticize it as an incomplete or outdated measure of intelligence, it still remains very influential because it was one of the first serious attempts to define machine intelligence in human terms.
incomplete.zh: 虽然许多专家现在将其批评为一种不完全或过时的智能衡量标准，但它依然极具影响力，因为它是最早严肃尝试用人类语言来定义机器智能的尝试之一。

injection.en: He chose the treatment, which involved regular hormone injections and had severe physical and psychological side effects.
injection.zh: 他选择了这种治疗，其中涉及定期的激素注射，并带来了严重的生理和心理副作用。

inform.en: In theory, democratic systems, democracy, depends on informed citizens.
inform.zh: 从理论上讲，民主制度依赖于知情的公民。

inform.en: An informed citizen is a person who can evaluate evidence, compare arguments, and make choices based on facts or information.
inform.zh: 一个知情的公民是指能够评估证据、比较论点并根据事实或信息做出选择的人。

intuition.en: He could arrive at the correct answer through intuition, natural ability, rather than calculation.
intuition.zh: 他可以通过直觉和天分得出正确答案，而不是靠计算。

infinity.en: Most famously, the “Man Who Knew Infinity” starring Dev Patel.
infinity.zh: 最著名的当属由戴夫·帕特尔（Dev Patel）主演的《知无涯者》（“Man Who Knew Infinity”）。

indirect.en: A euphemism is a polite or indirect way to talk about something uncomfortable, like “passed away” instead of died.
indirect.zh: 委婉语是谈论某些令人不适的事情时一种礼貌或间接的方式，比如用“passed away”代替“died”。

indirect.en: Now let’s move on to euphemisms. Euphemisms are another type of indirect or figurative language that you’ll hear all the time.
indirect.zh: 接下来我们来看看委婉语。委婉语是你经常会听到的另一种间接或比喻性的语言。

instructor.en: My instructors spoke quickly. They used technical language and they expected me to immediately understand.
instructor.zh: 我的教练语速很快。他们使用专业术语，并期望我能立即听懂。

instructor.en: I would then use that word while talking to my driving instructors.
instructor.zh: 接着我会跟我的驾校教练说话时使用那个词。
